summary: StageRunState does not implement the required attempts array.
evidence: src/types.ts:261-265 declares `attempts: any`, despite the approved slice requiring an attempts array on StageRunState. This accepts both the legacy numeric counter used by src/runner.ts and arbitrary invalid values, so downstream attempt-memory code receives neither an AttemptRecord[] API nor compiler protection.
suggestedRemediation: Replace `any` with a deliberate, type-safe migration representation that exposes AttemptRecord[] (and adjust the planned counter migration at its owned slice), rather than using `any` to bypass the contract.
